items.actClause: AN ACT to amend the navigation law, in relation to the authorized reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for local navigation enforcement expenditures
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S909

 TITLE OF BILL :

An act to amend the navigation law, in relation to the authorized
reimbursement rate paid to governmental entities for local navigation
enforcement expenditures

 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :

This legislation will change the maximum reimbursement rate from 50%
to 75% for municipalities to enforce the navigation law in that
municipality.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :

Section 1 changes the reimbursement rate from 50% to 75% for
enforcement of the navigation law located within that municipality.

Section 2 is the effective date.

 JUSTIFICATION :

Up until 2010 when there was a fiscal cliff, municipalities were
reimbursed up to a maximum of 75% of their expenditures for
reimbursement for enforcement of the navigation law within their
borders. This is seen by the State Police as voluntary enforcement,
however without their enforcement of the navigation law these laws
would go unenforced. This legislation seeks to return to 75% the
amount of money being reimbursed to them. As local police agencies
have taken over the majority of enforcement of these laws from State
Police their reimbursement should be as such. These municipalities
having waterways have a duty and obligation to patrol and enforce
these laws and should be reimbursed as such.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :

S. 6675/A. 9366 of 2016 Passed Senate

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :

To be determined.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
This act shall take effect immediately.
